newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on commercial, fund buying.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on commercial, fund buying.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on commercial and fund buying, traders said.

"Cargill bought 500 March, sold 300 July and sold 200 November while UGG liquidated 200 March longs. Funds were good buyers of the March. The spreads are tightening because the visible supplies are so low," a trader said. March futures crush profit margin fell to -28.27 from -26.59 Friday on CBOT soy oil, meal. Mar-May spread at $0.70, Mar-Nov $34, May-July $0.50. Volume was 4,300 lots or 86,000 tonnes with 200 hedges.
Japan bought 2,000-3,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola up $2.10 to $405.80, May up $1.20 to $404.70.
May flax fell $0.50 to $343.50, November flax rose $0.50 to $317.30. Thirty Mar-May spread at $2.50, May-July $2.
February western barley lost $1.30 to $138 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold to commission houses, March down $0.70 to $136.50 on hedges met by commercial and local buying.
March feed wheat rose $0.10 to $170.10, May rose $0.40 to $166.50 on commercial sales to commission and local buyers.
UGG bought five May feed peas unchanged at US$197. Oats did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats and peas.)
